crossRefs.note: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons…
God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish…
The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons…
Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.”
Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.
Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive plants around your…
Behold, thus is the man blessed who fears Yahweh.
Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

people.name: Arpachshad
people.line: Son of Shem, ancestor of Abraham

people.name: Shem
people.line: Noah's son, ancestor of Semitic peoples

translations.web: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
translations.bsb: And after he had become the father of Arphaxad, Shem lived 500 years and had other sons and daughters.
translations.kjv: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
translations.asv: and Shem lived after he begat Arpachshad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
